desc: Derive the GF(2) cell equations: Type A ⇒ top⊕bottom=1 and left⊕right=1; Type B ⇒ top⊕bottom=0, left⊕right=0, top⊕left=1.
Identify torus boundary variables and glue half-edges into one variable per physical edge (wrap-around included); 2HW variables total.
Reduce Hh-chain and V-chain per column/row: consistency requires every row and every column to contain an even number of A tiles; otherwise answer 0.
Express general solution as x[i][j]=a_j⊕G[i][j], y[i][j]=b_i⊕Hh[i][j]; each B cell gives a_j⊕b_i = 1⊕G[i][j]⊕Hh[i][j].
Conclude answer = 0 if any row/column A-count is odd or the XOR system is contradictory; else 2^C mod 998244353 where C = number of connected components over the H+W nodes (isolated included).

Implement the O(HW) DSU-with-parity solver (par[x]=value[x]⊕value[parent[x]], union-by-size, path compression), running Gcol/hprefix prefix parities in O(1) per cell, fast stdin/stdout, and modular power.
Validate implementation on Sample 1 (PASSED: 2, 0, 2) along with hand checks (all-A 2×2 = 16, all-B 2×2 = 2, H=2 column-parity edge case, odd row-sum ⇒ 0).
